correctness.rationale: The signed heat-kernel row identities are obtained by invariant-space diagonalization for eigenvalues 0,1,n,n+1. Optimal W1 transport costs are exactly F_n, G_n, e^{-nt}; nonpositive ordinary rows follow from exponential convexity. Their comparison and differentiation establish the full all-dimension/time theorem. An independent matrix-exponential plus transport LP script passed 147 sampled graph/time instances; universal proof is analytic.

value.rationale: An isolated leaf on an otherwise completely connected unit graph creates an exact threshold: heat regularity is contractive for clique sizes 2–3, transiently expansive starting at 4, with exact finite-time profile and peak tending to the diameter upper envelope 2. This is a natural sharp bottleneck instability invariant, not a single arbitrary finite sample.
